svg.aria-label: Isometric line drawing of a rectangular circuit board. Eight copper lines leave eight SMA connectors on the left edge, converge into a tight parallel bundle across the middle of the board, then fan out again to eight connectors on the right edge. Animated pulses travel along each line.

g.text: one waveform enters each of eight lines through an SMA edge launch on the left.
through the middle the lines run 0.65 mm apart over a ground plane, and each leaks into its neighbours.
what arrives on the right is a mixture of all eight.
